products.name: Care Supreme
products.policyExcerpt: Single private room, unlimited recharge, no copay, and zero disease-specific sublimits — one of the cleanest base plans available.
products.description: Care Supreme offers single private room cover with no proportionate deduction, an unlimited recharge benefit, and no mandatory copay. It excludes the Reasonable & Customary clause.
benefits: Single private room with no proportionate deduction
Unlimited recharge for same and different illness
PED waiting period: 36 months with reduction option
products.policyWording: Policy wording explicitly excludes R&C deductions and defines covered procedures with fixed benefit tables.

policySections.title: Room Rent
policySections.content: Single private room. Proportionate deduction waived via in-built cover.

policySections.title: Recharge Benefit
policySections.content: Unlimited recharge applies to same and different illness within a policy year.

policySections.title: Waiting Periods
policySections.content: PED: 36 months. Specific ailments: 24 months. Initial: 30 days.

reviews.title: No nasty surprises
reviews.content: Cashless approved in under 4 hours. Room upgrade was honoured without a proportionate cut.
reviews.author: Minal P.

reviews.title: Great for families
reviews.content: Recharge kicked in automatically after we exhausted the base SI.
reviews.author: S. Krishnan

products.name: Star Comprehensive
products.policyExcerpt: Maternity, newborn, OPD, and hospital cash packed in one plan — good breadth but watch the disease sublimits.
products.description: Star Comprehensive bundles maternity, OPD, hospital cash, and newborn cover. Trade-off: several disease-specific sublimits and a 10% zone-based copay in non-home cities.
products.policyWording: Detailed annexures per benefit bucket. R&C clause applies for OPD reimbursements.

policySections.title: Maternity
policySections.content: After 2-year waiting period. Up to ₹50,000 normal, ₹75,000 LSCS.

policySections.title: Copay
policySections.content: 10% zone-based copay applies when treated outside home city.

reviews.title: Maternity worked well
reviews.content: Smooth maternity claim but got hit by zone copay when I was travelling.
reviews.author: Priya D.

products.name: Care Elevate Super Top-up
products.policyExcerpt: Aggregate annual deductible, broad coverage above threshold, and global hospitalisation add-on.
products.description: Care Elevate uses an aggregate annual deductible so all claims in a year count toward one threshold. Ideal for stacking above an employer group policy.
products.policyWording: Deductible tables, claim examples, and portability notes included. R&C clause excluded for IPD claims.

policySections.title: Deductible
policySections.content: Aggregate annual deductible. All claims in a year accumulate toward the single threshold.

policySections.title: Coverage Scope
policySections.content: IPD, daycare, AYUSH, and pre/post-hospitalisation covered above deductible.

reviews.title: Aggregate deductible is the key
reviews.content: Multiple small claims in the year accumulated and eventually triggered the top-up. Per-claim would never have.
reviews.author: Neha R.

products.name: Star Super Surplus
products.policyExcerpt: Affordable top-up with per-claim deductible — good as a backup but less flexible than aggregate variants.
products.description: Star Super Surplus is a cost-effective top-up. The per-claim deductible means each hospitalisation must individually cross the threshold before the top-up pays.
benefits: Very low premium for high SI
products.policyWording: Simple structure. R&C clause applies. Per-claim deductible means stacking with group cover is less seamless.

policySections.title: Deductible
policySections.content: Per-claim deductible. Each claim must individually exceed the threshold.

reviews.title: Per-claim caught me out
reviews.content: My two smaller claims didn't trigger the top-up individually even though they would have exceeded aggregate.
reviews.author: Arun K.

products.name: HDFC Life Click 2 Protect Super
products.policyExcerpt: CSR 99.5%, whole-life option, CI rider covering 60 illnesses, limited-pay available.
products.description: A strong term plan with excellent insurer metrics. CI rider covers 60 critical illnesses. Whole-life and limited-pay options available. Upfront underwriting reduces post-claim disputes.
products.policyWording: Exclusions clearly defined. Suicide clause: 1 year. Non-disclosure contestability: 3 years per IRDAI mandate.

policySections.title: Riders
policySections.content: CI rider (60 illnesses), ADB, WOP on disability or CI, terminal illness payout.

policySections.title: Exclusions
policySections.content: Suicide within first year. Death due to declared hazardous activity. Non-disclosure: contestable within 3 years.

reviews.title: Smooth claim process
reviews.content: Claim settled within 10 days. The upfront medical underwriting meant no disputes.
reviews.author: Ravi S.

products.name: Max Life Smart Secure Plus
products.policyExcerpt: CSR 99.3%, joint-life option, return-of-premium variant, CI rider covering 64 illnesses.
products.description: Max Life Smart Secure Plus differentiates with a joint-life option for couples and a return-of-premium variant. CI rider covers 64 illnesses — among the broadest in the market.
products.policyWording: Comprehensive wording. Upfront tele-medical underwriting done at issuance.

policySections.title: Joint Life
policySections.content: Single policy covers two lives. Payout on first death; second life continues at no extra premium for 2 years.

reviews.title: Joint life is a great value
reviews.content: Both my spouse and I covered under one policy. CI payout was swift.
reviews.author: Kavya M.

products.name: HDFC ERGO Comprehensive Car Insurance
products.policyExcerpt: Zero depreciation, engine protection, consumables, RTI, and NCB protection — the full add-on stack.
products.description: HDFC ERGO Optima Comprehensive bundles all key add-ons: zero depreciation, engine protection, consumables, return to invoice, NCB protection, and 24/7 RSA. 13,000+ cashless garages.
benefits: Engine protection: hydrostatic lock + oil leakage
products.policyWording: Standard IRDAI motor policy wording. Exclusions: drunk driving, unlicensed driver, undeclared modifications.

policySections.title: Own Damage
policySections.content: Full own damage cover with all add-ons. ZD eliminates depreciation deduction on replaced parts.

policySections.title: Key Exclusions
policySections.content: Undeclared CNG/LPG modification. Driving under influence. Invalid licence.

reviews.title: Engine claim fully paid
reviews.content: Hydrostatic lock after flooding. Engine protection covered the full ₹1.4L repair without depreciation deduction.
reviews.author: Dinesh V.

products.name: Bajaj Allianz Two Wheeler Package
products.policyExcerpt: Zero depreciation, NCB protection, and pillion PA cover — strong 2-wheeler package.
products.description: Bajaj Allianz Two Wheeler Package provides zero depreciation, NCB protection, consumables, RSA, and personal accident cover for rider (₹15L) and pillion (₹1L).
products.policyWording: Standard motor wording. Undeclared CNG conversion voids own-damage claims.

policySections.title: Personal Accident
policySections.content: Rider: ₹15L mandatory PA. Pillion: ₹1L optional PA add-on.

policySections.title: Key Exclusions
policySections.content: Undeclared modification. Driving without valid licence. Racing.

reviews.title: ZD made the repair worthwhile
reviews.content: Minor accident would have cost ₹8K out-of-pocket without zero dep. Paid ₹0.
reviews.author: Arjun T.
